FINDING SEVERITY: blocking
FINDING LOCATION: model/layers.py:98-113 (with train_rqvae.py:247-248)
FINDING DETAIL: The implementation is the unchanged baseline Euclidean RQ-VAE. Assignment is torch.argmin over ||r_i - c_j||^2 (layers.py:98-104, 113), or the original Euclidean Sinkhorn on centered Euclidean distances at the last level only (layers.py:81-96, 106-112). There is no directed transition matrix, no Markov diffusion P <- (1-alpha)P + alpha*(B_bt @ P), no Poincare ground cost, no exp/log maps, no curved quantization and no hyperbolic Klein/Einstein barycenter code anywhere. train_rqvae.py:247-248 reads train.parquet only to take unique "target" item ids; no session/sequence column is touched, so no training-only behaviour signal is computed at all. The hyperbolic functions in model/utils.py:17-59 and 162-329 are dead code: grep finds no reference outside utils.py, and neither model/__init__.py nor model/layers.py imports utils. This is exactly the prohibited "unused hyperbolic helper / behaviour suffix on an unchanged Euclidean quantizer" case, except the helpers are not even imported.
FINDING REPRODUCTION: grep -R "transition\|markov\|diffus\|Einstein\|Klein\|barycenter" over the tree returns only the unrelated EMA "alpha" at layers.py:196-197; grep -R "from .utils\|import utils" returns nothing; read layers.py:98-113 and observe argmin over Euclidean distances. Additionally, the existing Euclidean Sinkhorn is training-only and last-level only; the SID export calls get_indices(..., infer_use_sk=False) at train_rqvae.py:415-417, which reaches the argmin branch at layers.py:107-113.
FINDING CORRECTION: Implement the proposal inside the single assignment block: build the directed item-transition matrix from training sessions and index it by the batch item ids (train_rqvae.py:247-248 must feed a transition loader into the model); per level compute p_i=exp_0(r_i), the Poincare distance matrix, K=exp(-D/tau) with tau measured on the first batch, the three Sinkhorn sweeps with the Markov diffusion step and the measured q, argmax over P for the index, and the hyperbolic weighted barycenter codebook update with the plan weights. Remove or wire the dead utils helpers so that one path uses both signals.

There is no behaviour switch, no geometry switch and no both-on/off wiring anywhere in the tree, so nothing can change SID assignment or gradients when "switched on", and nothing can revert when behaviour is off or the curve is replaced by Euclidean distance. The only hyperbolic ops (model/utils.py:162-329) are never instantiated or called, so they receive no gradient; the only trainable quantization parameters are the Euclidean nn.Embedding weights (layers.py:62), updated through the Euclidean quant_loss. There is therefore no coupled term whose gradient could reach the intended parameters.
